title: Laredo's 4th Annual Día de los Muertos celebration set for November 7 at North Central Park
excerpt: The City of Laredo's 4th Annual Día de los Muertos celebration comes to North Central Park on Saturday, November 7, with a Catrina Contest, mariachi, ballet folklórico and a Glow 5K.
content:
The City of Laredo invites the community to celebrate culture, tradition and remembrance at the 4th Annual Día de los Muertos, taking place Saturday, November 7, 2026, from 4 p.m. to 9 p.m. at North Central Park, 10202 International Blvd.

Now in its fourth year, the celebration brings families, friends and neighbors together to honor loved ones and celebrate the traditions surrounding the holiday through music, art, food and family-friendly activities. District 6 Council Member Dr. Tyler King and the Rotary Club of Laredo Next Generation presented the details at a joint press conference, inviting the community to take part in the growing annual tradition.

This year's festivities will feature a Catrina Contest, food vendors, mariachi, ballet folklórico, informational booths and more, with something for residents of all ages. The evening will also include the Día de los Muertos X RotaRun Glow 5K, beginning at 7 p.m. — participants are encouraged to embrace the Día de los Muertos theme and bring their own glow items; glow sticks will also be provided. Separate registration is required for the Catrina Contest and for the 5K.

Día de los Muertos, observed November 1 and 2, is rooted in Indigenous traditions in which families welcome back the spirits of loved ones with ofrendas, flowers, food, music and memories. Laredo's city celebration extends that remembrance into a shared community evening a few days later, on November 7.

What to watch next: registration details for the Catrina Contest and the Glow 5K, and the city's final program lineup as November 7 approaches.
